review_policy: Keep per-target vocabulary reading and meaning evidence separate; wrong compounds or conjugated forms do not automatically demote individual component characters. Mix weak, critical, familiar and mastered using 50/25/15/10 proportions where verified accuracy exists; classify untested as unknown, not critical. Rotate missed targets across intervening items and sessions (1, 3, 7, 14), with successful items at 7, 14 and 30 sessions.

next_lesson_priorities.policy: All N5–N2 permitted; N1 prohibited. Whole-word assessment controls review; do not change independent character status from compound mistakes.
next_lesson_priorities.recognition_rule: Unknown app targets remain tagged unknown in immutable export; explicit story difficulty is a separate weak review flag. Do not infer isolated mastery or weakness for N5 components from compounds alone.

familiar.description: I can recognize those kanjis after 10 secs.
familiar.meaning: Recognizes after approximately ten seconds; slow retrieval, not confidently mastered.
familiar.lesson_treatment: Revisit regularly with varied context, measuring reduced hesitation; no automatic promotion.

weak.description: I don't know the reading or meaning.
weak.meaning: Lacks the reading or the meaning, potentially both.
weak.lesson_treatment: Prioritize for reading/meaning reinforcement and keep weak until explicitly reassessed.

unknown.description: That means that kanji is very new to me.
unknown.meaning: Very new vocabulary/kanji to the learner.
unknown.lesson_treatment: Introduce through readable context, then revisit; do not presume any previous recognition.

mastered.description: App-export label; learner definition not yet supplied.
mastered.meaning: Retain as labeled by app, without inventing a recall-time threshold.
mastered.lesson_treatment: Reuse as comfortable supporting vocabulary unless later story feedback reports difficulty.
